runs.purpose: The supplied RTL implements the Neorv32 bus infrastructure: it arbitrates and multiplexes requests from multiple masters (A, B, core, main, etc.) to shared device/system ports (x_req_o/sys_req_o/device_req_o), decodes addresses to target device ports, optionally registers requests/responses, implements AMO (read-modify-write) and RVS store-conditional semantics, and monitors outstanding transactions for timeouts; it reads master request ports, holds/arbitrates state, and drives request and response ports to devices and masters.

flows.value: transaction start (strobe): a master's stb is captured/accumulated and the arbiter asserts the internal start decision copied to the outgoing request strobe
request multiplexing/forwarding: the selected master's request fields (addr, data, rw, src, priv, lock, amo, amoop, debug, ben, fence) are forwarded to the shared output x_req_o
request lock capture and hold: per-request lock bits are captured into locked/locked_nxt and hold or release the busy state
response aggregation and forwarding: responses from devices are OR-aggregated (gateway) and gated back to the requesting master (a_rsp_o, b_rsp_o) with error/ack gating by selection and keeper.err
AMO read-modify-write: core_req_i triggers a read, the arbiter captures rdata, the ALU computes alu_res, the core issues a write with alu_res to sys_req_o and finally the core receives the response
RVS store-conditional result: rvso detection and sc_result set sc_fail, which alters the core response (ack/data)
registers and state are cleared by active-low rstn_i (bus switch, regs, gateway keeper, AMO arbiter and ALU, RVS sc_fail)

runs.purpose: This RTL file implements the neorv32 bus infrastructure: arbitration and multiplexing between masters A/B and the external system port X (neorv32_bus_switch), optional request/response register staging (neorv32_bus_reg), address decoding and per-port request routing (neorv32_bus_gateway / neorv32_bus_io_switch), and AMO RMW / RVS sequencing and ALU result computation (neorv32_bus_amo_rmw, neorv32_bus_amo_rvs). Inputs are decoded and gated, selected request fields are driven to downstream ports, responses are aggregated and forwarded, and internal state registers sequence transactions.

runs.purpose: A collection of bus fabrics: a switch that arbitrates between local masters (ports A/B) and forwards the chosen request to an external bus (x_req_o) and returns responses; a gateway that decodes request addresses to per-port requests and aggregates device responses; optional request/response register stage; and AMO/RVS units that implement atomic read-modify-write and reservation semantics with timeout monitoring.

flows.value: Issue of a selected master request on the external bus (assemble x_req_o fields and assert x_req_o.stb)
Arbitration and hold/release sequencing (state machine keeps S_IDLE / S_BUSY_A / S_BUSY_B and latches/clears a_req/b_req)
Forward external responses back to the selected master (data copied; ack/err gated by the grant decision)
Address decode and per-port request generation (gateway: compute port_sel from req_i.addr and produce port_req(i))
Aggregate device responses into int_rsp and drive external rsp_o (data copy; ack/err ORed; keeper.err influences ack/err)
Request-monitoring and timeout (keeper): detect start of request, count cycles, set err on timeout and clear on response or lock change
AMO RMW sequence and compute: schedule read, capture rdata, compute alu_res, and drive write (sys_req_o.data) during write phase
Reservation (RVS) flow: compute rvso, control request forwarding for RVS, set sc_fail on store-conditional failure, and encode sc result into core response
Reset to known values (clear arbiter/switch/gateway registers and keeper state under rstn_i)
